operating_principle: Monitor the whole game, not a single season. S1 is the baseline for new servers; S2 and later seasons are server/version-scoped overlays. Every acquisition cycle checks the global source families; season-specific findings are tagged, never generalized.

cost_policy.rule: Zero-paid-first architecture. Use native/web discovery, GitHub, Notion and connected free-access paths first. Metered acquisition is opt-in and budget-controlled. No recurring paid monitor remains active without an explicit budget decision. Deduplicate and fingerprint before any metered extraction.

evidence_tiers.T1: direct current in-game evidence; exact proposition visibly established

server_and_season_model.rule: A source is never applied globally when its scope is season/server/version-specific.

tools.TOOL-01: Notion — human evidence control, verification, conflicts, source/plugin master
tools.TOOL-02: GitHub — code, schemas, tests, release snapshots and machine-readable manifests
tools.TOOL-03: Supabase — persistent learning/data laboratory and analytics store
tools.TOOL-04: Firecrawl — broad discovery, crawl, extraction, image discovery and scheduled change detection
tools.TOOL-05: TinyFish — free search/fetch first; metered browser automation only when interaction is required
tools.TOOL-07: LLM — synthesis, inference, benchmark generation; never canonical authority

redundancy_policy: Where 2–3 tools can perform the same task, compare outputs, preserve provenance, and select the strongest supported result without deleting disagreement.
promotion_rule: No automatic canonical T1 promotion. User/session evidence may affect the current answer provisionally; promotion requires appropriate evidence and auditable verification.

monitoring.name: FGF V4 — Global Source Discovery — 6h
monitoring.status: Firecrawl recurring monitor disabled to protect zero-cost target
monitoring.scope: all FGF seasons/server states; mechanics, progression, resource/Power formulas, events, buildings, Champions, Flagships, Technology, economy, PvP, ports, bugs, fixes, patches, guides, testing, official announcements, social, Reddit, Discord, YouTube/videos/playlists, images and store updates
monitoring.budget_rule: Keep recurring acquisition at zero paid credits by default. Use Firecrawl/TinyFish only for targeted deep acquisition when a source cannot be handled by free/native discovery; record any metered use in the control log before scaling it.
